hgss2-1.name: Jirachi
hgss2-1.description: Generations have believed that any wish written on a note on its head will come true when it awakens.

abilities.name: Stardust Song
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, when you put Jirachi from your hand onto your Bench, you may flip 3 coins. For each heads, search your discard pile for a Psychic Energy card and attach it to Jirachi.

attacks.name: Time Hollow
attacks.effect: Choose a number of your opponent's Stage 1 or Stage 2 Evolved Pokémon up to the amount of Energy attached to Jirachi. Remove the highest Stage Evolution card from each of those Pokémon and put those cards back into your opponent's hand.

hgss2-2.name: Magmortar
hgss2-2.description: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit out of its arms. Its breath also sears and sizzles.

attacks.name: Hard Crush
attacks.effect: Discard the top 3 cards from your deck. This attack does 50 damage times the number of Energy cards you discarded.

attacks.name: Mantle Bazooka
attacks.effect: Discard 2 Fire Energy attached to Magmortar.

hgss2-3.name: Manaphy
hgss2-3.description: It starts its life with a wondrous power that permits it to bond with any kind of Pokémon.

attacks.name: Deep Sea Swirl
attacks.effect: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 5 cards.

abilities.name: Psychic Float
abilities.effect: If you have any Psychic Energy attached to your Active Pokémon, the Retreat Cost for that Pokémon is 0.

attacks.name: Double Leg Hammer
attacks.effect: Choose 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. This attack does 40 damage to each of them. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

hgss2-5.name: Mismagius
hgss2-5.description: Its cries sound like incantations to torment the foe. It appears where you least expect it.

abilities.name: Magical Trans
abilities.effect: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may move a Psychic Energy attached to 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon. This power can't be used if Mismagius is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Psychic Pulse
attacks.effect: Does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has any damage counters on it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

hgss2-6.name: Octillery
hgss2-6.description: It traps foes with the suction cups on its tentacles, then smashes them with its rock-hard head.

attacks.name: Switch Cannon
attacks.effect: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) Switch Octillery with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Ink Bomb
attacks.effect: If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.

hgss2-7.name: Politoed
hgss2-7.description: Whenever three or more of these get together, they sing in a loud voice that sounds like bellowing.

abilities.name: Leap Frog
abilities.effect: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may choose a Water Pokémon on your Bench and switch it with your Active Pokémon. This power can't be used if Politoed is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Big Chorus
attacks.effect: Flip a coin for each Water Pokémon you have in play. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

hgss2-8.name: Shaymin
hgss2-8.description: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.

abilities.name: Celebration Wind
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, when you put Shaymin from your hand onto your Bench, you may move as many Energy cards attached to your Pokémon as you like to any of your other Pokémon.

attacks.name: Energy Bloom
attacks.effect: Remove 3 damage counters from each of your Pokémon that has any Energy attached to it.

hgss2-9.name: Sudowoodo
hgss2-9.description: It disguises itself as a tree to avoid attack. It hates water, so it will disappear if it starts raining.

attacks.name: Push Over
attacks.effect: Does 20 damage times the amount of Fighting Energy attached to Sudowoodo.

attacks.name: Rumble
attacks.effect: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

hgss2-10.name: Torterra
hgss2-10.description: Ancient people imagined that beneath the ground, a gigantic Torterra dwelled.

attacks.name: Giga Drain
attacks.effect: Remove from Torterra the number of damage counters equal to the damage you did to the Defending Pokémon.

hgss2-11.name: Xatu
hgss2-11.description: In South America, it is said that its right eye sees the future and its left eye views the past.

attacks.name: Psywave
attacks.effect: Does 20 damage times the amount of Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Confuse Ray
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

hgss2-12.name: Beedrill
hgss2-12.description: It can take down any opponent with its powerful poison stingers. It sometimes attacks in swarms.

attacks.name: Twineedle
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 50 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Paralyze Poison
attacks.effect: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is also Paralyzed.

hgss2-13.name: Blastoise
hgss2-13.description: It deliberately makes itself heavy so it can withstand the recoil of the water jets it fires.

abilities.name: Wash Out
abilities.effect: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may move a Water Energy attached to 1 of your Benched Pokémon to your Active Pokémon. This power can't be used if Blastoise is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Hydro Launcher
attacks.effect: Return 2 Water Energy attached to Blastoise to your hand. Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 100 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

hgss2-14.name: Crobat
hgss2-14.description: The development of wings on its legs enables it to fly fast but also makes it tough to stop and rest.

attacks.name: Supersonic
attacks.effect: The Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Hurricane Wing
attacks.effect: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

hgss2-15.name: Fearow
hgss2-15.description: It shoots itself suddenly high into the sky, then plummets down in one fell swoop to strike its prey.

attacks.name: Repeating Drill
attacks.effect: Flip 5 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

hgss2-16.name: Floatzel
hgss2-16.description: With its flotation sac inflated, it can carry people on its back. It deflates the sac before it dives.

abilities.name: Water Acceleration
abilities.effect: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may attach a Water Energy card from your hand to Floatzel. This power can't be used if Floatzel is affected by a Special Condition.

hgss2-17.name: Kingdra
hgss2-17.description: It sleeps deep on the ocean floor to build its energy. It is said to cause tornadoes as it wakes.

attacks.name: Water Arrow
attacks.effect: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Stream Pump
attacks.effect: You may do 50 damage plus 30 more damage. If you do, return an Energy card attached to Kingdra to your hand.

hgss2-18.name: Lanturn
hgss2-18.description: The light it emits is so bright that it can illuminate the sea’s surface from a depth of over three miles.

attacks.name: Confuse Ray
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Reflect Energy
attacks.effect: Move an Energy card attached to Lanturn to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

hgss2-19.name: Lucario
hgss2-19.description: It’s said that no foe can remain invisible to Lucario, since it can detect auras, even foes it could not otherwise see.

attacks.name: Bulk Up
attacks.effect: During your next turn, each of Lucario's attacks does 30 more damage to the Defending Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

hgss2-20.name: Ninetales
hgss2-20.description: Some legends claim that each of its nine tails has its own unique type of special mystical power.

attacks.name: Heat Acceleration
attacks.effect: Search your discard pile for up to 3 Fire Energy cards and attach them to 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Searing Flame
attacks.effect: The Defending Pokémon is now Burned.

hgss2-21.name: Poliwrath
hgss2-21.description: Although an energetic, skilled swimmer that uses all of its muscles, it lives on dry land.

attacks.name: Steamroll
attacks.effect: Does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Dynamic Punch
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 60 damage plus 40 more damage and the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

hgss2-22.name: Primeape
hgss2-22.description: If approached while asleep, it may awaken and angrily give chase in a groggy state of semi-sleep.

attacks.name: Bebop Punch
attacks.effect: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 50 damage times the number of heads to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

hgss2-23.name: Roserade
hgss2-23.description: Its sweet aroma attracts prey. Then it spews poison. The more toxic it is, the sweeter its aroma.

abilities.name: Energy Signal
abilities.effect: When you attach a Grass Energy card or Psychic Energy card from your hand to Roserade during your turn, you may use this power. If you attach a Grass Energy card, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused. If you attach a Psychic Energy card, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. This power can't be used if Roserade is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Power Blow
attacks.effect: Does 20 damage times the amount of Energy attached to Roserade.

hgss2-24.name: Steelix
hgss2-24.description: Its body has been compressed deep under the ground. As a result, it is even harder than a diamond.

attacks.name: Guard Press
attacks.effect: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Steelix by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Steel Swing
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 80 damage times the number of heads.

hgss2-25.name: Torkoal
hgss2-25.description: You find abandoned coal mines full of them. They dig tirelessly in search of coal.

abilities.name: Hot Snort
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, when you put Torkoal from your hand onto your Bench, you may flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Burned.

hgss2-26.name: Tyranitar
hgss2-26.description: Extremely strong, it can change the landscape. It has an insolent nature that makes it not care about others.

attacks.name: Tail Crush
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 damage plus 20 more damage.

attacks.name: Hyper Beam
attacks.effect: Discard an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.

hgss2-27.name: Ursaring
hgss2-27.description: With its ability to distinguish any aroma, it unfailing finds all food buried deep underground.

attacks.name: Cross Chop
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 50 damage plus 30 more damage.

hgss2-28.name: Cherrim
hgss2-28.description: During times of strong sunlight, its bud blooms, its petals open fully, and it becomes very active.

abilities.name: Sunny Heal
abilities.effect: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may remove 1 damage counter from your Active Pokémon. This power can't be used if Cherrim is affected by a Special Condition.

hgss2-29.name: Dunsparce
hgss2-29.description: When spotted, this Pokémon escapes backward by furiously boring into the ground with its tail.

attacks.name: Return
attacks.effect: Draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand.

hgss2-30.name: Golbat
hgss2-30.description: It can drink more than 10 ounces of blood at once. If it has too much, it gets heavy and flies clumsily.

attacks.name: Mean Look
attacks.effect: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

hgss2-31.name: Grotle
hgss2-31.description: A Grotle that lives in the forest is said to have its own secret springwater.

attacks.name: Sleep Powder
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

hgss2-32.name: Kakuna
hgss2-32.description: Although it is a cocoon, it can move a little. It can extend its poison barb if it is attacked.

attacks.name: Speed Evolution
attacks.effect: Search your deck for a card that evolves from Kakuna and put it onto Kakuna. (This counts as evolving Kakuna.) Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Poison Sting
attacks.effect: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

hgss2-33.name: Metang
hgss2-33.description: When two Beldum fuse together, a magnetic nervous system places their brains in union.

attacks.name: Energy Crane
attacks.effect: Search your discard pile for up to 2 Psychic Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like.

hgss2-34.name: Minun
hgss2-34.description: Exposure to electricity from Minun and Plusle promotes blood circulation and relaxes muscles.

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.effect: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Tag Team Boost
attacks.effect: If Plusle is on your Bench, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage.

hgss2-35.name: Numel
hgss2-35.description: The flaming magma it stores in the hump on its back is the source of its tremendous power.

attacks.name: Flare Bonus
attacks.effect: Discard a Fire Energy card from your hand. Then, draw 3 cards.

hgss2-36.name: Plusle
hgss2-36.description: It absorbs electricity from telephone poles. It shorts out its body to create crackling noises.

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.effect: Draw 2 cards.

attacks.name: Thunder Jolt
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, Plusle does 10 damage to itself.

hgss2-37.name: Poliwhirl
hgss2-37.description: The skin on most of its body is moist. However, the skin on its belly spiral feels smooth.

attacks.name: Hypnoblast
attacks.effect: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

hgss2-38.name: Pupitar
hgss2-38.description: Its shell is as hard as sheet rock, and it is also very strong. Its thrashing can topple a mountain.

abilities.name: Boost Gas
abilities.effect: If Pupitar has any Energy attached to it, the Retreat Cost of Pupitar is 0.

attacks.name: Rage
attacks.effect: Does 20 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on Pupitar.

hgss2-39.name: Pupitar
hgss2-39.description: Even sealed in its shell, it can move freely. Hard and fast, it has outstanding destructive power.

hgss2-40.name: Seadra
hgss2-40.description: Its fin tips leak poison. Its fins and bones are highly valued as ingredients in herbal medicine.

attacks.name: Muddy Water
attacks.effect: Does 10 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

hgss2-41.name: Tauros
hgss2-41.description: They fight each other by locking horns. The herd’s protector takes pride in its battle-scarred horns.

attacks.name: Crimson Bull
attacks.effect: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads. Tauros is now Confused.

hgss2-42.name: Wartortle
hgss2-42.description: It is a well-established symbol of longevity. If its shell has algae on it, that Wartortle is very old.

attacks.name: Water Arrow
attacks.effect: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

hgss2-43.name: Aipom
hgss2-43.description: It lives atop tall trees. When leaping from branch to branch, it deftly uses its tail for balance.

attacks.name: Tail Code
attacks.effect: Move an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon to another of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Tail Smash
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

hgss2-44.name: Beldum
hgss2-44.description: The magnetic force generated by its body repels the ground’s natural magnetism, letting it float.

attacks.name: Reaction
attacks.effect: You may switch Beldum with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

hgss2-45.name: Buizel
hgss2-45.description: It inflates its flotation sac, keeping its face above water in order to watch for prey movement.

attacks.name: Muddy Water
attacks.effect: Does 10 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

hgss2-46.name: Carnivine
hgss2-46.description: It walks around on its tentacles in search of a tree branch where it can dangle down and ambush prey.

attacks.name: Drawup Power
attacks.effect: Search your deck for an Energy card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

hgss2-47.name: Cherubi
hgss2-47.description: It evolves by sucking the energy out of the small ball where it had been storing nutrients.

hgss2-48.name: Chinchou
hgss2-48.description: It shoots positive and negative electricity between the tips of its two antennae and zaps its enemies.

hgss2-49.name: Horsea
hgss2-49.description: Its big, developed fins move rapidly, allowing it to swim backward while still facing forward.

attacks.name: Fin Smack
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

hgss2-50.name: Larvitar
hgss2-50.description: It feeds on soil. After it has eaten a large mountain, it will fall asleep so it can grow.

attacks.name: Mountain Eater
attacks.effect: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck. Then, remove 2 damage counters from Larvitar.

attacks.name: Reckless Charge
attacks.effect: Larvitar does 10 damage to itself.

hgss2-51.name: Larvitar
hgss2-51.description: It is born deep underground. It can’t emerge until it has entirely consumed the soil around it.

hgss2-52.name: Magmar
hgss2-52.description: It dislikes cold places, so it blows scorching flames to make the environment suitable for itself.

hgss2-53.name: Mankey
hgss2-53.description: It is extremely ill-tempered. Groups of them will attack any handy target for no reason.

attacks.name: Karate Chop
attacks.effect: Does 40 damage minus 10 damage for each damage counter on Mankey.

hgss2-54.name: Misdreavus
hgss2-54.description: It likes playing mischievous tricks such as screaming and wailing to startle people at night.

attacks.name: Sharpshooting
attacks.effect: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 10 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

hgss2-55.name: Natu
hgss2-55.description: It usually forages for food on the ground but may, on rare occasions, hop onto branches to peck at shoots.

attacks.name: Teleport
attacks.effect: Switch Natu with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

hgss2-56.name: Onix
hgss2-56.description: It rapidly bores through the ground at 50 mph by squirming and twisting its massive, rugged body.

abilities.name: Energy Healer
abilities.effect: Whenever you attach an Energy card from your hand to Onix, remove a damage counter from Onix.

attacks.name: Boundless Power
attacks.effect: Onix can't attack during your next turn.

hgss2-57.name: Onix
hgss2-57.description: It twists and squirms through the ground. The thunderous roar of its tunneling echoes a long way.

attacks.name: Swing Around
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage for each heads.

hgss2-58.name: Poliwag
hgss2-58.description: The direction of its belly spiral differs by area. The equator is thought to have an effect on this.

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.effect: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.

hgss2-59.name: Remoraid
hgss2-59.description: It has superb accuracy. The water it shoots out can strike even moving prey from more than 300 feet.

attacks.name: Water Arrow
attacks.effect: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

hgss2-60.name: Riolu
hgss2-60.description: They communicate with one another using their auras. They are able to run all through the night.

attacks.name: Double Chop
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

hgss2-61.name: Roselia
hgss2-61.description: Roselia that drink nutritionally rich springwater are said to reveal rare coloration when they bloom.

attacks.name: Petal Dance
attacks.effect: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads. Roselia is now Confused.

hgss2-62.name: Spearow
hgss2-62.description: It flaps its short wings to flush out insects from tall grass. It then plucks them with its stubby beak.

attacks.name: Roost
attacks.effect: Remove 4 damage counters from Spearow. Spearow can't retreat during your next turn.

hgss2-63.name: Squirtle
hgss2-63.description: The shell is soft when it is born. It soon becomes so resilient, prodding fingers will bounce off it.

hgss2-64.name: Stantler
hgss2-64.description: The curved antlers subtly change the flow of air to create a strange space where reality is distorted.

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.effect: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Mystifying Horns
attacks.effect: The Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

hgss2-65.name: Teddiursa
hgss2-65.description: Before food becomes scarce in wintertime, its habit is to hoard food in many hidden locations.

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.effect: Teddiursa does 10 damage to itself.

hgss2-66.name: Tropius
hgss2-66.description: The bunch of fruit around its neck ripens twice a year and is delicious. It’s a highly favored tropical snack.

attacks.name: Green Call
attacks.effect: Flip 2 coins. For each heads, search your deck for a Grass Pokémon, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. If you do, shuffle your deck afterward.

hgss2-67.name: Turtwig
hgss2-67.description: Photosynthesis occurs across its body under the sun. The shell on its back is actually hardened soil.

attacks.name: Leech Seed
attacks.effect: If this attack does any damage to the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance), remove 1 damage counter from Turtwig.

hgss2-68.name: Vulpix
hgss2-68.description: As it develops, its single white tail gains color and splits into six. It is quite warm and cuddly.

attacks.name: Fireworks
attacks.effect: Flip a coin. If tails, discard a Fire Energy attached to Vulpix.

hgss2-69.name: Weedle
hgss2-69.description: Its poison stinger is very powerful. Its bright-colored body is intended to warn off its enemies.

attacks.name: Speed Evolution
attacks.effect: Search your deck for a card that evolves from Weedle and put it onto Weedle. (This counts as evolving Weedle.) Shuffle your deck afterward.

hgss2-70.name: Zubat
hgss2-70.description: Capable of flying safely in dark places, it emits ultrasonic cries to check for any obstacles.

attacks.name: Double Attack
attacks.effect: Choose 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. This attack does 10 damage to each of them. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

hgss2-71.name: Cheerleader's Cheer
hgss2-71.effect: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card. Draw 3 cards. Your opponent may draw a card.

hgss2-72.name: Dual Ball
hgss2-72.effect: Flip 2 coins. For each heads, search your deck for a Basic Pokémon, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. If you do, shuffle your deck afterward.

hgss2-73.name: Emcee's Chatter
hgss2-73.effect: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card. Flip a coin. If heads, draw 3 cards. If tails, draw 2 cards.

hgss2-74.name: Energy Returner
hgss2-74.effect: Search your discard pile for 4 basic Energy cards, show them to your opponent, and shuffle them into your deck.

hgss2-75.name: Engineer's Adjustments
hgss2-75.effect: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card. Discard an Energy card from your hand. Then, draw 4 cards.

hgss2-76.name: Good Rod
hgss2-76.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, search your discard pile for a Pokémon, show it to your opponent, and put it on top of your deck. If tails, search your discard pile for a Trainer card, show it to your opponent, and put it on top of your deck.

hgss2-77.name: Interviewer's Questions
hgss2-77.effect: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card. Look at the top 8 cards of your deck. Choose as many Energy cards as you like, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.

hgss2-78.name: Judge
hgss2-78.effect: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card. Each player shuffles his or her hand into his or her deck and draws 4 cards.

hgss2-79.name: Life Herb
hgss2-79.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of your Pokémon, and remove all Special Conditions and 6 damage counters from that Pokémon (all if there are less than 6).

hgss2-80.name: PlusPower
hgss2-80.effect: Attach PlusPower to 1 of your Pokémon. Discard this card at the end of your turn. If the Pokémon PlusPower is attached to attacks, the attack does 10 more damage to the Defending Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

hgss2-81.name: Pokémon Circulator
hgss2-81.effect: Your opponent switches his or her Active Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

hgss2-82.name: Rare Candy
hgss2-82.effect: Choose 1 of your Basic Pokémon in play. If you have a Stage 1 or Stage 2 card that evolves from that Pokémon in your hand, put that card on the Basic Pokémon. (This counts as evolving that Pokémon.) If you choose a Stage 2 Pokémon in your hand, put that Pokémon on the Basic Pokémon instead of on a Stage 1 Pokémon.

hgss2-83.name: Super Scoop Up
hgss2-83.effect: Flip a coin. If heads, return 1 of your Pokémon and all cards attached to it to your hand.

attacks.name: Severe Poison
attacks.effect: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. Put 4 damage counters instead of 1 on that Pokémon between turns.

attacks.name: Skill Dive
attacks.effect: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

abilities.name: Spray Splash
abilities.effect: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may put 1 damage counter on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This power can't be used if Kingdra is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Dragon Steam
attacks.effect: If your opponent has any Fire Pokémon in play, this attack's base damage is 20 instead of 60.

abilities.name: Underwater Dive
abilities.effect: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may use this power. Lanturn's type is Water until the end of your turn. This power can't be used if Lanturn is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Powerful Spark
attacks.effect: Does 40 damage plus 10 more damage for each Energy attached to all of your Pokémon.

abilities.name: Perfect Metal
abilities.effect: Steelix can't be affected by any Special Conditions

attacks.name: Energy Stream
attacks.effect: Search your discard pile for an Energy card and attach it to Steelix.

attacks.name: Gaia Crush
attacks.effect: You may discard any Stadium card in play.

attacks.name: Darkness Howl
attacks.effect: This attack does 20 damage to each Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) (excluding any Darkness Pokémon). (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Power Claw
attacks.effect: This attack's damage isn't affected by Poké-Powers, Poké-Bodies, or any other effects on the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Megaton Tail
attacks.effect: Discard the top 3 cards of your deck.
